mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for three consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 2% YoY and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is below 1% and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously, and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for three consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is increased by more than 50 basis points in a single meeting, it signals a rapid tightening of monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
